about: Verbatim-trimmed snapshot of what the National Parks MCP server returned during research on 2026-09-29. The NPS API key was used only inside the local MCP server configuration and appears nowhere in this project. The public site reads only this static snapshot and never calls the NPS API.

calls.result: 57 loosely matched parks returned (fuzzy text search). None of the returned parks is Meridian Hill Park; results began with Abraham Lincoln Birthplace, Adams, Agate Fossil Beds.
calls.interpretation: Meridian Hill Park is not a standalone unit in the NPS parks API.

calls.result: 36 NPS parks listed for DC. The string 'Meridian' appears zero times in the full response.

result.name: Rock Creek Park
result.description: Rock Creek Park is truly a gem in our nation's capital. This 1,754 acre city park was officially authorized in 1890, making it the third national park to be designated by the federal government.
result.directionsInfo_excerpt: Rock Creek Park also administers 99 separate neighborhood small sites.
result.operatingHours: Unless otherwise designated, all park land is open sunrise to sunset.
